desc: The Wheeler Engineering Professional Gunsmithing File Set is perfect for many different gunsmithing jobs. The set comes with a wide grade of files from a rough rasp all the way down to a super, extra fine diamond plate. Whether you are reshaping a wood stock or smoothing out an action, this set is perfect for you. Includes 1: 8" half round file, 8" flat file, 6" square file, 6" triangle file, 6" round file, 4-n-1 Rasp, File Cleaning Brush, Super Extra Fine Diamond Plate, Stick of File Chalk, Small Flat Coarse Grit Diamond File, Small Round Coarse Grit Diamond File, Small Triangle Coarse Grit Diamond File, Small Flat Medium Grit Diamond File, Small Round Medium Grit Diamond File, Small Triangle Medium Grit Diamond File, Small Flat Fine Grit Diamond File, Small Round Fine Grit Diamond File, Small Triangle Fine Grit Diamond File.
